minimality_note: Retains the upstream main.py -> TrainExperiment -> Point Maze loader -> NanoWM/SD-VAE -> MetricsLogger sampling path byte-for-byte outside the declared excision. Unselected planning, semantic codecs, game, LeRobot, PushT and deformable data sources are omitted. The upstream default config still requires configs/planning/base.yaml. Evaluator-side pruned_imports.py satisfies eager imports of omitted backends with constructors that fail if selected; it never replaces the selected execution path.

evaluator_adapters.reason: Installs evaluator-only import and unscored FID adapters before main.py; records each dfot_sample latent on the candidate's machine and returns those latents in call order on the trusted runner.
Runner side of the judge: device check and checkpoint conversion, the native reference run and the native decode of the candidate's latents, and the per-clip metrics.
Builds the candidate machine's public Point Maze data: actions, and per clip only the context frame.
